hooks.command: PY=python3; python3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1 || PY=python; $PY -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "guard.py: no working python interpreter; blocking" >&2; exit 2; }; $PY "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/guard.py"; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || { [ "$rc" -eq 2 ] || echo "guard.py crashed (exit $rc); failing closed" >&2; exit 2; }
if command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1; then powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/protect-env.ps1"; fi
